> ```csharp
> 1	using DigitalBrain.Abstractions;
> 2	using DigitalBrain.Core;
> 3	using DigitalBrain.ServiceDefaults;
> 4	using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
> 5	using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
> 6	using Orleans.Configuration;
> 7	using Orleans.Dashboard;
> 8	
> 9	namespace DigitalBrain.Aspire;
> 10	
> 11	public static class DigitalBrainRuntimeHostingExtensions
> 12	{
> 13	    // Deliberate Azure Queue stream layout for a small single-silo product composition:
> 14	    // ~8 physical queues, ~20 streams/queue headroom (2× safety). Visibility is double a
> 15	    // one-minute cache window. Azure Queue streams are at-least-once, not rewindable, and
> 16	    // not FIFO under failure — weaker than the durable synapse outbox; do not move outbox
> 17	    // traffic onto this provider.
> 18	    internal const int StreamQueueCount = 8;
> 19	    internal static readonly TimeSpan StreamMessageVisibilityTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(2);
> 20	
> 21	    public static IHostApplicationBuilder AddDigitalBrain(
> 22	        this IHostApplicationBuilder builder,
> 23	        ModuleAssemblies modules)
> 24	    {
> 25	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(builder);
> 26	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(modules);
> 27	
> 28	        builder.AddServiceDefaults();
> 29	        builder.AddKeyedAzureTableServiceClient(DigitalBrainResourceNames.Clustering);
> 30	        builder.AddKeyedAzureTableServiceClient(DigitalBrainResourceNames.Reminders);
> 31	        builder.AddKeyedAzureQueueServiceClient(DigitalBrainResourceNames.Streams);
> 32	        builder.AddKeyedAzureTableServiceClient(DigitalBrainResourceNames.PubSub);
> 33	        builder.UseOrleans(silo =>
> 34	        {
> 35	            silo.AddDigitalBrainJournalStorage(builder.Configuration);
> 36	            DigitalBrainRuntime.Add(silo, modules);
> 37	            silo.Services
> 38	                .AddOptions<HashRingStreamQueueMapperOptions>(DigitalBrainResourceNames.StreamProviderName)
> 39	                .Configure(options => options.TotalQueueCount = StreamQueueCount);
> 40	            silo.Services
> 41	                .AddOptions<AzureQueueOptions>(DigitalBrainResourceNames.StreamProviderName)
> 42	                .Configure(options => options.MessageVisibilityTimeout = StreamMessageVisibilityTimeout);
> 43	            silo.AddDashboard(options =>
> 44	            {
> 45	                options.CounterUpdateIntervalMs = 5000;
> 46	                options.HistoryLength = 200;
> 47	            });
> 48	        });
> 49	        builder.AddDigitalBrainOwner(activateOnStart: false);
> 50	        return builder;
> 51	    }
> 52	}
> ```

> ```csharp

> 8	{
> 9	    public static string JournalConnectionName => DigitalBrainResourceNames.JournalConnectionName;
> 10

> 13	
> 14	    public static DigitalBrainBuilder AddDigitalBrain(this IDistributedApplicationBuilder builder, string name)
> 15	    {
> 16	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(builder);
> 17	        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(name);
> 18	
> 19	        var storage = builder
> 20	            .AddAzureStorage(DigitalBrainResourceNames.Storage)
> 21	            .RunAsEmulator();
> 22	        var clustering = storage.AddTables(DigitalBrainResourceNames.Clustering);
> 23	        var reminders = storage.AddTables(DigitalBrainResourceNames.Reminders);
> 24	        var journal = storage.AddBlobs(DigitalBrainResourceNames.JournalResource);
> 25	        var streams = storage.AddQueues(DigitalBrainResourceNames.Streams);
> 26	        var pubSub = storage.AddTables(DigitalBrainResourceNames.PubSub);
> 27	        var orleans = builder
> 28	            .AddOrleans(name)
> 29	            .WithClustering(clustering)
> 30	            .WithReminders(reminders)
> 31	            .WithGrainStorage(DigitalBrainResourceNames.PubSubStoreName, pubSub)
> 32	            .WithStreaming(DigitalBrainResourceNames.StreamProviderName, streams);
> 33	        var brain = new DigitalBrainBuilder(builder, name, orleans, journal, streams, pubSub);
> 34	
> 35	        brain.RequireHealthyBeforeStart(storage.Resource);
> 36	        brain.RequireHealthyBeforeStart(clustering.Resource);
> 37	        brain.RequireHealthyBeforeStart(reminders.Resource);
> 38	        brain.RequireHealthyBeforeStart(journal.Resource);
> 39	        return brain;
> 40	    }
> 41	
> 42	    public static DigitalBrainBuilder WithLocalDevelopmentOAuthCallback(
> 43	        this DigitalBrainBuilder brain,
> 44	        Uri callbackUri)
> 45	    {
> 46	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(brain);
> 47	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(callbackUri);
> 48	        if (!callbackUri.IsAbsoluteUri)
> 49	        {
> 50	            throw new ArgumentException(
> 51	                "The local-development OAuth callback must be an absolute URI.",
> 52	                nameof(callbackUri));
> 53	        }
> 54	
> 55	        if (!OAuthCallbackPaths.EndsWithCanonicalCallback(callbackUri))
> 56	        {
> 57	            throw new ArgumentException(
> 58	                $"The local-development OAuth callback must end with '{OAuthCallbackPaths.RelativePath}' "
> 59	                + $"(the path the kernel serves). Received '{callbackUri}'.",
> 60	                nameof(callbackUri));
> 61	        }
> 62	
> 63	        brain.UseLocalDevelopmentOAuthCallback(callbackUri.AbsoluteUri);
> 64	        return brain;
> 65	    }
> 66

> 241	        JournalKind kind,
> 242	        [NotNullWhen(true)] out ChannelJournalObserver? observer,
> 243	        [NotNullWhen(true)] out IJournalObserver? reference)
> 244	    {
> 245	        var candidate = new ChannelJournalObserver(kind);
> 246	        try
> 247	        {
> 248	            reference = _grains.CreateObjectReference<IJournalObserver>(candidate);
> 249	            observer = candidate;
> 250	            return true;
> 251	        }
> 252	        catch (InvalidOperationException ex) when (
> 253	            ex.Message.Contains("object reference", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
> 254	        {
> 255	            candidate.Complete();
> 256	            observer = null;
> 257	            reference = null;
> 258	            return false;

> 262	    private static async Task<Synapse> WaitForResponseAsync(
> 263	        ChannelJournalObserver observer,
> 264	        CorrelationId correlation,
> 265	        Type responseType,
> 266	        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 267	    {
> 268	        await foreach (var page in observer.Reads.ReadAllAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false))
> 269	        {
> 270	            foreach (var delivery in page.Delta)
> 271	            {
> 272	                if (delivery.CorrelationId == correlation
> 273	                    && responseType.IsInstanceOfType(delivery.Synapse))
> 274	                {
> 275	                    return delivery.Synapse;
> 276	                }
> 277	            }
> 278	        }
> 279	
> 280	        throw new InvalidOperationException(
> 281	            $"The session journal watch ended before a '{responseType.Name}' response arrived for correlation '{correlation}'.");
> 282	    }

> 284	    private static async Task<Synapse> PollForResponseAsync(

> 287	        long cursor,
> 288	        CorrelationId correlation,

> 291	    {
> 292	        while (true)
> 293	        {
> 294	            var read = await session.ReadNeuronJournal(sessionId, JournalKind.Incoming, cursor).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 295	            foreach (var candidate in read.Delta)
> 296	            {
> 297	                if (candidate.CorrelationId == correlation
> 298	                    && responseType.IsInstanceOfType(candidate.Synapse))
> 299	                {
> 300	                    return candidate.Synapse;
> 301	                }
> 302	            }
> 303

> 306	                throw new InvalidOperationException(

> 308	                    + $"'{responseType.Name}' response arrived for correlation '{correlation}'.");
> 309	            }
> 310	
> 311	            cursor = read.ResumeSequence;
> 312	            await Task.Delay(ResponsePollInterval, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 313	        }
> 314	    }

> 8	namespace DigitalBrain.Core;
> 9	
> 10	public interface ISynapseTransform
> 11	{
> 12	    string Name { get; }
> 13	
> 14	    Synapse Apply(Synapse synapse);

> 16	
> 17	public sealed class DeclarativeSynapseTransform : ISynapseTransform
> 18	{
> 19	    private const string Prefix = "to:";
> 20	
> 21	    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Shaping = new()
> 22	    {
> 23	        PropertyNamingPolicy = JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase,
> 24	        PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true,
> 25	    };
> 26	
> 27	    private readonly Type _targetType;
> 28	    private readonly IReadOnlyList<(string Target, string Source)> _mappings;
> 29	
> 30	    private DeclarativeSynapseTransform(
> 31	        string name,
> 32	        Type targetType,
> 33	        IReadOnlyList<(string Target, string Source)> mappings)
> 34	    {
> 35	        Name = name;
> 36	        _targetType = targetType;
> 37	        _mappings = mappings;
> 38	    }
> 39	
> 40	    public string Name { get; }
> 41	
> 42	    public Type TargetType => _targetType;
> 43	
> 44	    public IReadOnlyList<(string Target, string Source)> Mappings => _mappings;
> 45	
> 46	    public static DeclarativeSynapseTransform? TryParse(string transformName)
> 47	    {
> 48	        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(transformName)
> 49	            || !transformName.StartsWith(Prefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
> 50	        {
> 51	            return null;
> 52	        }
> 53	
> 54	        var spec = transformName[Prefix.Length..].Trim();
> 55	        var brace = spec.IndexOf('{', StringComparison.Ordinal);
> 56	        string alias;
> 57	        List<(string, string)> mappings = [];
> 58	
> 59	        if (brace < 0)
> 60	        {
> 61	            alias = spec;
> 62	        }
> 63	        else
> 64	        {
> 65	            if (!spec.EndsWith('}'))
> 66	            {
> 67	                return null;
> 68	            }
> 69	
> 70	            alias = spec[..brace].Trim();
> 71	            foreach (var pair in spec[(brace + 1)..^1].Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries))
> 72	            {
> 73	                var separator = pair.IndexOf('=', StringComparison.Ordinal);
> 74	                if (separator <= 0 || separator == pair.Length - 1)
> 75	                {
> 76	                    return null;
> 77	                }
> 78	
> 79	                mappings.Add((pair[..separator].Trim(), pair[(separator + 1)..].Trim()));
> 80	            }
> 81	        }
> 82	
> 83	        return SynapseTypeIndex.FindByAlias(alias) is not { } targetType
> 84	            ? null
> 85	            : new DeclarativeSynapseTransform(transformName, targetType, mappings);
> 86	    }
> 87	
> 88	    public Synapse Apply(Synapse synapse)
> 89	    {
> 90	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(synapse);
> 91	
> 92	        if (JsonSerializer.SerializeToNode(synapse, synapse.GetType(), Shaping) is not JsonObject carried)
> 93	        {
> 94	            throw new InvalidOperationException(
> 95	                $"'{synapse.GetType().Name}' did not shape into a JSON object for '{Name}'.");
> 96	        }
> 97	
> 98	        var shaped = new JsonObject();
> 99	        foreach (var (target, source) in _mappings)
> 100	        {
> 101	            if (carried.TryGetPropertyValue(JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase.ConvertName(source), out var value))
> 102	            {
> 103	                shaped[JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase.ConvertName(target)] = value?.DeepClone();
> 104	            }
> 105	        }
> 106	
> 107	        return JsonSerializer.Deserialize(shaped, _targetType, Shaping) as Synapse
> 108	            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(
> 109	                $"'{Name}' produced no '{_targetType.Name}' from a '{synapse.GetType().Name}'.");
> 110	    }
> 111	}
> 112	
> 113	public static class SynapseTypeIndex
> 114	{
> 115	    private static readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, Type?> Resolved = new(StringComparer.Ordinal);
> 116	
> 117	    public static Type? FindByAlias(string synapseAlias)
> 118	    {
> 119	        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(synapseAlias))
> 120	        {
> 121	            return null;
> 122	        }
> 123	
> 124	        return Resolved.GetOrAdd(synapseAlias, static alias =>
> 125	        {
> 126	            Type? found = null;
> 127	
> 128	            foreach (var assembly in AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies())
> 129	            {
> 130	                if (assembly.IsDynamic
> 131	                    || assembly.GetName().Name is not { } name
> 132	                    || !name.StartsWith("DigitalBrain", StringComparison.Ordinal))
> 133	                {
> 134	                    continue;
> 135	                }
> 136	
> 137	                foreach (var type in SafeTypes(assembly))
> 138	                {
> 139	                    if (type is not { IsClass: true, IsAbstract: false }
> 140	                        || !typeof(Synapse).IsAssignableFrom(type)
> 141	                        || !string.Equals(SynapseAlias.Of(type), alias, StringComparison.Ordinal))
> 142	                    {
> 143	                        continue;
> 144	                    }
> 145	
> 146	                    if (found is not null && found != type)
> 147	                    {
> 148	                        return null;
> 149	                    }
> 150	
> 151	                    found = type;
> 152	                }
> 153	            }
> 154	
> 155	            return found;
> 156	        });
> 157	    }
> 158	
> 159	    private static IEnumerable<Type> SafeTypes(Assembly assembly)
> 160	    {
> 161	        try
> 162	        {
> 163	            return assembly.GetTypes();
> 164	        }
> 165	        catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException partial)
> 166	        {
> 167	            return partial.Types.OfType<Type>();
> 168	        }
> 169	    }

> **`src/Kernel/DigitalBrain.Core/Capabilities/ModuleReflection.cs`** — ManifestOf(method), ModuleReflection(class), Humanized(method), NeuronContracts(method), FactVocabulary(method), ContractsSuffix(constant), +10 more

> ```csharp
> 1	using System.Reflection;
> 2	using System.Text;
> 3	using DigitalBrain.Abstractions;
> 4	
> 5	namespace DigitalBrain.Core;
> 6	
> 7	public static class ModuleReflection
> 8	{
> 9	    private const string ContractsSuffix = ".Contracts";
> 10	    private const string DefaultInstanceMemberName = "DefaultInstanceName";
> 11	
> 12	    public static CapabilityManifest ManifestOf(Assembly contracts)
> 13	    {
> 14	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(contracts);
> 15	
> 16	        var assemblyName = contracts.GetName().Name
> 17	            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("A contracts assembly must carry a name.");
> 18	        var moduleName = assemblyName.EndsWith(ContractsSuffix, StringComparison.Ordinal)
> 19	            ? assemblyName[..^ContractsSuffix.Length]
> 20	            : assemblyName;
> 21	
> 22	        return new CapabilityManifest(
> 23	            new ModuleId(moduleName),
> 24	            "1.0.0",
> 25	            Humanized(moduleName[(moduleName.LastIndexOf('.') + 1)..]),
> 26	            [.. NeuronContracts(contracts).Select(Described)],
> 27	            [.. FactVocabulary(contracts)]);
> 28	    }
> 29	
> 30	    private static IEnumerable<Type> NeuronContracts(Assembly contracts)
> 31	        => SafeTypes(contracts)
> 32	            .Where(static type => type is { IsInterface: true, IsPublic: true }
> 33	                && type != typeof(INeuron)
> 34	                && typeof(INeuron).IsAssignableFrom(type))
> 35	            .OrderBy(static type => type.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal);
> 36	
> 37	    private static NeuronCapabilityDescriptor Described(Type neuronContract)
> 38	    {
> 39	        var accepted = HandledSynapses(neuronContract)
> 40	            .Select(DescriptorFor)
> 41	            .ToArray();
> 42	        var emitted = HandledSynapses(neuronContract)
> 43	            .Select(ReplyTypeOf)
> 44	            .OfType<Type>()
> 45	            .Distinct()
> 46	            .Select(DescriptorFor)
> 47	            .ToArray();
> 48	
> 49	        return new NeuronCapabilityDescriptor(
> 50	            ContractIdOf(neuronContract),
> 51	            Humanized(TrimmedInterfaceName(neuronContract)),
> 52	            DefaultInstanceNameOf(neuronContract),
> 53	            accepted,
> 54	            emitted);
> 55	    }
> 56	
> 57	    private static IEnumerable<Type> HandledSynapses(Type neuronContract)
> 58	        => neuronContract.GetInterfaces()
> 59	            .Where(static contract => contract.IsGenericType
> 60	                && contract.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(IHandle<>))
> 61	            .Select(static contract => contract.GenericTypeArguments[0])
> 62	            .OrderBy(static synapse => synapse.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal);
> 63	
> 64	    private static IEnumerable<SynapseCapabilityDescriptor> FactVocabulary(Assembly contracts)
> 65	        => SafeTypes(contracts)
> 66	            .Where(static type => type is { IsClass: true, IsAbstract: false }
> 67	                && typeof(Synapse).IsAssignableFrom(type))
> 68	            .OrderBy(static type => type.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal)
> 69	            .Select(DescriptorFor);
> 70	
> 71	    private static IEnumerable<Type> SafeTypes(Assembly assembly)
> 72	    {
> 73	        try
> 74	        {
> 75	            return assembly.GetTypes();
> 76	        }
> 77	        catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException partiallyLoaded)
> 78	        {
> 79	            return partiallyLoaded.Types.OfType<Type>();
> 80	        }
> 81	    }
> 82	
> 83	    private static SynapseCapabilityDescriptor DescriptorFor(Type synapse)
> 84	        => new(
> 85	            SynapseAlias.Of(synapse) ?? synapse.Name,
> 86	            1,
> 87	            Humanized(synapse.Name),
> 88	            CapabilitySchema.For(synapse));
> 89	
> 90	    private static Type? ReplyTypeOf(Type synapse)
> 91	    {
> 92	        for (var probed = synapse.BaseType; probed is not null; probed = probed.BaseType)
> 93	        {
> 94	            if (probed.IsGenericType && probed.GetGenericTypeDefinition() == typeof(RequestSynapse<>))
> 95	            {
> 96	                return probed.GenericTypeArguments[0];
> 97	            }
> 98	        }
> 99	
> 100	        return null;
> 101	    }
> 102	
> 103	    private static string ContractIdOf(Type neuronContract)
> 104	        => neuronContract.GetCustomAttributesData()
> 105	                .FirstOrDefault(static attribute => attribute.AttributeType == typeof(AliasAttribute))?
> 106	                .ConstructorArguments[0].Value as string
> 107	            ?? TrimmedInterfaceName(neuronContract).ToLowerInvariant();
> 108	
> 109	    private static string DefaultInstanceNameOf(Type neuronContract)
> 110	        => neuronContract.GetField(DefaultInstanceMemberName)?.GetRawConstantValue() as string
> 111	            ?? neuronContract.GetField("InstanceName")?.GetRawConstantValue() as string
> 112	            ?? "default";
> 113	
> 114	    private static string TrimmedInterfaceName(Type contract)
> 115	        => contract.Name.Length > 1 && contract.Name[0] == 'I' && char.IsUpper(contract.Name[1])
> 116	            ? contract.Name[1..]
> 117	            : contract.Name;
> 118	
> 119	    // "StartTimer" → "Start timer"; "time.start-timer" callers pass type names, not aliases.
> 120	    private static string Humanized(string identifier)
> 121	    {
> 122	        var words = new StringBuilder(identifier.Length + 8);
> 123	
> 124	        for (var index = 0; index < identifier.Length; index++)
> 125	        {
> 126	            var letter = identifier[index];
> 127	            if (index > 0 && char.IsUpper(letter) && !char.IsUpper(identifier[index - 1]))
> 128	            {
> 129	                words.Append(' ').Append(char.ToLowerInvariant(letter));
> 130	                continue;
> 131	            }
> 132	
> 133	            words.Append(letter);
> 134	        }
> 135	
> 136	        return words.ToString();
> 137	    }
> 138	}

> 8	    INeuron participant,
> 9	    NeuronId id,
> 10	    TaskScheduler turnScheduler,
> 11	    ParticipantInvocations invocations) : IChatClient
> 12	{
> 13	    private readonly Func<IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage>, CancellationToken, IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate>> _stream =
> 14	        StreamingInvocationFor(participant);
> 15	
> 16	    public Task<ChatResponse> GetResponseAsync(
> 17	        IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages,
> 18	        ChatOptions? options = null,
> 19	        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
> 20	        => GetStreamingResponseAsync(messages, options, cancellationToken).ToChatResponseAsync(cancellationToken);
> 21	
> 22	    public async IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate> GetStreamingResponseAsync(
> 23	        IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages,
> 24	        ChatOptions? options = null,
> 25	        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
> 26	    {
> 27	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(messages);
> 28	        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
> 29	
> 30	        var updates = _stream(Request(messages, options), cancellationToken)
> 31	            .GetAsyncEnumerator(cancellationToken);
> 32	
> 33	        try
> 34	        {
> 35	            bool carrying;
> 36	
> 37	            try
> 38	            {
> 39	                carrying = await MoveNextOnTurnAsync(updates, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 40	            }
> 41	            catch (Exception failure)
> 42	            {
> 43	                invocations.RecordFailure(id, failure);
> 44	                throw;
> 45	            }
> 46	
> 47	            invocations.RecordInvocation();
> 48	
> 49	            while (carrying)
> 50	            {
> 51	                yield return updates.Current;
> 52	
> 53	                carrying = await MoveNextOnTurnAsync(updates, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 54	            }
> 55	        }
> 56	        finally
> 57	        {
> 58	            await DisposeOnTurnAsync(updates).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 59	        }
> 60	    }
> 61	
> 62	    public object? GetService(Type serviceType, object? serviceKey = null)
> 63	        => serviceType.IsInstanceOfType(this) ? this : null;
> 64	
> 65	    public void Dispose()
> 66	    {
> 67	    }
> 68	
> 69	    private Task<bool> MoveNextOnTurnAsync(
> 70	        IAsyncEnumerator<ChatResponseUpdate> updates,
> 71	        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 72	        => Task.Factory.StartNew(
> 73	            () => updates.MoveNextAsync().AsTask(),
> 74	            cancellationToken,
> 75	            TaskCreationOptions.DenyChildAttach,
> 76	            turnScheduler).Unwrap();
> 77	
> 78	    private Task DisposeOnTurnAsync(IAsyncEnumerator<ChatResponseUpdate> updates)
> 79	        => Task.Factory.StartNew(
> 80	            () => updates.DisposeAsync().AsTask(),
> 81	            CancellationToken.None,
> 82	            TaskCreationOptions.DenyChildAttach,
> 83	            turnScheduler).Unwrap();
> 84	
> 85	    private static Func<IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage>, CancellationToken, IAsyncEnumerable<ChatResponseUpdate>>
> 86	        StreamingInvocationFor(INeuron participant)
> 87	    {
> 88	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(participant);
> 89	
> 90	        return participant switch
> 91	        {
> 92	            ILLM model => model.RespondStreaming,
> 93	            IAgent agent => agent.RespondStreaming,
> 94	            _ => throw new ArgumentException(
> 95	                $"AI participant '{participant.GetType().FullName}' must implement {nameof(ILLM)} or {nameof(IAgent)}.",
> 96	                nameof(participant)),
> 97	        };
> 98	    }
> 99	
> 100	    private static IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage> Request(IEnumerable<ChatMessage> messages, ChatOptions? options)
> 101	    {
> 102	        var request = messages as IReadOnlyList<ChatMessage> ?? messages.ToArray();
> 103	
> 104	        return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(options?.Instructions)
> 105	            ? request
> 106	            : [new ChatMessage(ChatRole.System, options.Instructions), .. request];
> 107	    }
> 108	}

> 163	    protected override async Task OnUnboundSynapseAsync(Synapse synapse, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 164	    {
> 165	        if (synapse is not AuthorizationRequired required)
> 166	        {
> 167	            await base.OnUnboundSynapseAsync(synapse, cancellationToken)
> 168	                .ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 169	            return;
> 170	        }
> 171	
> 172	        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
> 173	        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(required.ServerDisplayName))
> 174	        {
> 175	            throw new NeuronAuthorizationException($"Chat '{Id}' refuses a sign-in offer without a server name.");
> 176	        }
> 177	
> 178	        var label = $"Sign in via {required.ServerDisplayName}";
> 179	        var buttonId = $"sign-in-{required.ServerKey}";
> 180	        var action = required.SignInUrl.AbsoluteUri;
> 181	        ChatButtonOffer[] buttons = [new ChatButtonOffer(buttonId, label, action)];
> 182	        var text = $"{required.ServerDisplayName} needs sign-in before that request can continue.";
> 183	        Remember(new ChatTurn(FromUser: false, text, buttons));
> 184	        await EmitAsync(new Responded(required.CommandId, Id, text, buttons))
> 185	            .ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 186	    }
> 187	
> 188	    private async Task ArmOfferedButtonAsync(CommandId offer, string buttonId)
> 189	    {
> 190	        var button = NeuronId.For<IButton>(Id.Owner, ChatButtons.OfferedInstanceName(Id.Name, offer, buttonId));
> 191	        var graphId = ISynapseGraph.ForOwner(Id.Owner);
> 192	
> 193	        await SendAsync(
> 194	            graphId,
> 195	            new Connect(
> 196	                ChatButtons.ArmingConnectionId(button),
> 197	                button,
> 198	                ButtonActivated.AliasName,
> 199	                Id,
> 200	                ButtonActivatedToShowTime.TransformName,
> 201	                TimeProvider.GetUtcNow() + ChatButtons.OfferLifetime)).ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 202	
> 203	        // The offer must not reach the owner before the click route is live, or an
> 204	        // immediate click emits an activation with no receiver and is lost.
> 205	        using var arming = new CancellationTokenSource(DeliveryPolicy.ConnectionLookupTimeout);
> 206	        await FlushOutboxAsync(arming.Token).ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 207	
> 208	        var routes = await GrainFactory
> 209	            .GetGrain<ISynapseGraph>(graphId.ToGrainId())
> 210	            .ConnectionsFrom(button, ButtonActivated.AliasName)
> 211	            .WaitAsync(arming.Token).ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 212	        if (routes.Count == 0)
> 213	        {
> 214	            throw new InvalidOperationException(
> 215	                $"Chat '{Id}' could not arm button '{button}' before offering it.");
> 216	        }
> 217	    }

> 264	    private bool IsUnseenCommand(SendMessage message)
> 265	    {
> 266	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(message);
> 267	        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(message.Text);
> 268	        if (message.CommandId.Value == Guid.Empty)
> 269	        {
> 270	            throw new ArgumentException("The command id cannot be empty.", nameof(message));
> 271	        }
> 272	
> 273	        for (var remembered = _commandLog.Count - 1; remembered >= 0; remembered--)
> 274	        {
> 275	            var command = _commands.Deserialize(_commandLog[remembered]);
> 276	            if (command.CommandId != message.CommandId.Value)
> 277	            {
> 278	                continue;
> 279	            }
> 280	
> 281	            if (!string.Equals(command.Text, message.Text, StringComparison.Ordinal))
> 282	            {
> 283	                throw new InvalidOperationException("A chat command id cannot be reused with different text.");
> 284	            }
> 285	
> 286	            return false;
> 287	        }
> 288	
> 289	        return true;
> 290	    }

> 166	        NeuronId receiver,

> 171	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(request);

> 182	        var sessionId = ISessionNeuron.ForOwner(Owner);

> 208	        }
> 209	        finally

> 240	    private bool TryCreateJournalObserver(
> 241	        JournalKind kind,
> 242	        [NotNullWhen(true)] out ChannelJournalObserver? observer,
> 243	        [NotNullWhen(true)] out IJournalObserver? reference)
> 244	    {
> 245	        var candidate = new ChannelJournalObserver(kind);
> 246	        try
> 247	        {
> 248	            reference = _grains.CreateObjectReference<IJournalObserver>(candidate);
> 249	            observer = candidate;
> 250	            return true;
> 251	        }
> 252	        catch (InvalidOperationException ex) when (
> 253	            ex.Message.Contains("object reference", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
> 254	        {
> 255	            candidate.Complete();
> 256	            observer = null;
> 257	            reference = null;
> 258	            return false;
> 259	        }
> 260	    }
> 261	
> 262	    private static async Task<Synapse> WaitForResponseAsync(
> 263	        ChannelJournalObserver observer,
> 264	        CorrelationId correlation,
> 265	        Type responseType,
> 266	        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 267	    {
> 268	        await foreach (var page in observer.Reads.ReadAllAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false))
> 269	        {
> 270	            foreach (var delivery in page.Delta)
> 271	            {
> 272	                if (delivery.CorrelationId == correlation
> 273	                    && responseType.IsInstanceOfType(delivery.Synapse))
> 274	                {
> 275	                    return delivery.Synapse;
> 276	                }
> 277	            }
> 278	        }
> 279	
> 280	        throw new InvalidOperationException(
> 281	            $"The session journal watch ended before a '{responseType.Name}' response arrived for correlation '{correlation}'.");
> 282	    }
> 283	
> 284	    private static async Task<Synapse> PollForResponseAsync(
> 285	        ISessionNeuron session,
> 286	        NeuronId sessionId,
> 287	        long cursor,
> 288	        CorrelationId correlation,
> 289	        Type responseType,
> 290	        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 291	    {
> 292	        while (true)
> 293	        {
> 294	            var read = await session.ReadNeuronJournal(sessionId, JournalKind.Incoming, cursor).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 295	            foreach (var candidate in read.Delta)
> 296	            {
> 297	                if (candidate.CorrelationId == correlation
> 298	                    && responseType.IsInstanceOfType(candidate.Synapse))
> 299	                {
> 300	                    return candidate.Synapse;
> 301	                }
> 302	            }
> 303	
> 304	            if (read.ResetSnapshot is not null)
> 305	            {
> 306	                throw new InvalidOperationException(
> 307	                    $"The session journal compacted past sequence {cursor} before a "
> 308	                    + $"'{responseType.Name}' response arrived for correlation '{correlation}'.");
> 309	            }
> 310	
> 311	            cursor = read.ResumeSequence;
> 312	            await Task.Delay(ResponsePollInterval, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 313	        }
> 314	    }
> 315	    private async Task TeardownWatchAsync(
> 316	        ISessionNeuron session,
> 317	        NeuronId subject,
> 318	        IJournalObserver reference,
> 319	        ChannelJournalObserver observer)
> 320	    {
> 321	        try
> 322	        {
> 323	            await session.UnwatchNeuron(subject, reference).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 324	        }
> 325	        catch (Exception)
> 326	        {
> 327	        }
> 328	
> 329	        try
> 330	        {
> 331	            _grains.DeleteObjectReference<IJournalObserver>(reference);
> 332	        }
> 333	        catch (Exception)
> 334	        {
> 335	        }
> 336	        finally
> 337	        {
> 338	            observer.Complete();
> 339	        }
> 340	    }
> 341	
> 342	    private static void RequireDomainNeuronContract(Type neuronType)
> 343	    {
> 344	        if (neuronType == typeof(INeuron)
> 345	            || typeof(ISessionNeuron).IsAssignableFrom(neuronType)
> 346	            || typeof(IDigitalBrainNeuron).IsAssignableFrom(neuronType))
> 347	        {
> 348	            throw new NeuronAuthorizationException(
> 349	                $"'{neuronType.Name}' is not addressable through IDigitalBrain.Get. Activate the brain with ActivateAsync; address domain neuron contracts with Get; fire synapses through FireAsync; observe journals through ReadJournalAsync and WatchJournalAsync.");
> 350	        }
> 351	    }
> 352	}

> 220	        => maxTurns is not { } cap || transcript.Turns.Count <= cap
> 221	            ? transcript
> 222	            : new ChatTranscript([.. transcript.Turns.Skip(transcript.Turns.Count - cap)]);

> 224	    private static bool WantsTimeButton(string text)
> 225	    {
> 226	        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
> 227	        {
> 228	            return false;
> 229	        }
> 230	
> 231	        var value = text.AsSpan().Trim();
> 232	        return value.Contains("button", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
> 233	            && value.Contains("time", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
> 234	    }

> 238	    private async Task<IAgent> ResponderAsync()
> 239	    {
> 240	        using var lookup = new CancellationTokenSource(DeliveryPolicy.ConnectionLookupTimeout);
> 241	        try
> 242	        {
> 243	            var routes = await GrainFactory
> 244	                .GetGrain<ISynapseGraph>(ISynapseGraph.ForOwner(Id.Owner).ToGrainId())
> 245	                .ConnectionsFrom(Id, ChatRoles.Responder)
> 246	                .WaitAsync(lookup.Token).ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 247	
> 248	            return routes.FirstOrDefault() is { } bound
> 249	                ? GrainFactory.GetGrain<IAgent>(bound.Target.ToGrainId())
> 250	                : DefaultResponder();
> 251	        }
> 252	        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (lookup.IsCancellationRequested)
> 253	        {
> 254	            return DefaultResponder();
> 255	        }
> 256	    }

> 264	    private bool IsUnseenCommand(SendMessage message)
> 265	    {
> 266	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(message);
> 267	        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(message.Text);
> 268	        if (message.CommandId.Value == Guid.Empty)
> 269	        {
> 270	            throw new ArgumentException("The command id cannot be empty.", nameof(message));
> 271	        }
> 272	
> 273	        for (var remembered = _commandLog.Count - 1; remembered >= 0; remembered--)
> 274	        {
> 275	            var command = _commands.Deserialize(_commandLog[remembered]);
> 276	            if (command.CommandId != message.CommandId.Value)
> 277	            {
> 278	                continue;
> 279	            }
> 280	
> 281	            if (!string.Equals(command.Text, message.Text, StringComparison.Ordinal))
> 282	            {
> 283	                throw new InvalidOperationException("A chat command id cannot be reused with different text.");
> 284	            }
> 285	
> 286	            return false;
> 287	        }
> 288	
> 289	        return true;
> 290	    }

> 26	file sealed class DurablePayloadProtector : IDurablePayloadProtector
> 27	{
> 28	    private const byte EnvelopeVersion = 1;
> 29	    private const int MasterKeyLength = 32;
> 30	    private const int NonceLength = 12;
> 31	    private const int TagLength = 16;
> 32	    private const int HeaderLength = 1 + NonceLength + TagLength;
> 33	    private static readonly byte[] AssociatedDataPrefix = "DigitalBrain.Security/v1/"u8.ToArray();
> 34	    private readonly byte[] masterKey;
> 35	
> 36	    internal DurablePayloadProtector(string encodedKey)
> 37	    {
> 38	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(encodedKey);
> 39	
> 40	        try
> 41	        {
> 42	            masterKey = Convert.FromBase64String(encodedKey);
> 43	        }
> 44	        catch (FormatException exception)
> 45	        {
> 46	            throw new ArgumentException("The durable state-protection key must be base64 encoded.", nameof(encodedKey), exception);
> 47	        }
> 48	
> 49	        if (masterKey.Length != MasterKeyLength)
> 50	        {
> 51	            throw new ArgumentException("The durable state-protection key must contain exactly 256 bits.", nameof(encodedKey));
> 52	        }
> 53	    }
> 54	
> 55	    public byte[] Protect(string purpose, ReadOnlySpan<byte> plaintext)
> 56	    {
> 57	        var purposeBytes = GetPurposeBytes(purpose);
> 58	        var derivedKey = HMACSHA256.HashData(masterKey, purposeBytes);
> 59	        var protectedPayload = new byte[HeaderLength + plaintext.Length];
> 60	        protectedPayload[0] = EnvelopeVersion;
> 61	
> 62	        var nonce = protectedPayload.AsSpan(1, NonceLength);
> 63	        var tag = protectedPayload.AsSpan(1 + NonceLength, TagLength);
> 64	        var ciphertext = protectedPayload.AsSpan(HeaderLength);
> 65	        RandomNumberGenerator.Fill(nonce);
> 66	
> 67	        try
> 68	        {
> 69	            using var encryption = new AesGcm(derivedKey, TagLength);
> 70	            encryption.Encrypt(nonce, plaintext, ciphertext, tag, purposeBytes);
> 71	            return protectedPayload;
> 72	        }
> 73	        finally
> 74	        {
> 75	            CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(derivedKey);
> 76	            CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(purposeBytes);
> 77	        }
> 78	    }
> 79	
> 80	    public byte[] Unprotect(string purpose, ReadOnlySpan<byte> protectedPayload)
> 81	    {
> 82	        if (protectedPayload.Length < HeaderLength || protectedPayload[0] != EnvelopeVersion)
> 83	        {
> 84	            throw new CryptographicException("The durable payload envelope is invalid or unsupported.");
> 85	        }
> 86	
> 87	        var purposeBytes = GetPurposeBytes(purpose);
> 88	        var derivedKey = HMACSHA256.HashData(masterKey, purposeBytes);
> 89	        var plaintext = new byte[protectedPayload.Length - HeaderLength];
> 90	
> 91	        try
> 92	        {
> 93	            using var encryption = new AesGcm(derivedKey, TagLength);
> 94	            encryption.Decrypt(
> 95	                protectedPayload[1..(1 + NonceLength)],
> 96	                protectedPayload[HeaderLength..],
> 97	                protectedPayload[(1 + NonceLength)..(1 + NonceLength + TagLength)],
> 98	                plaintext,
> 99	                purposeBytes);
> 100	            return plaintext;
> 101	        }
> 102	        catch
> 103	        {
> 104	            CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(plaintext);
> 105	            throw;
> 106	        }
> 107	        finally
> 108	        {
> 109	            CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(derivedKey);
> 110	            CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(purposeBytes);
> 111	        }
> 112	    }
> 113	
> 114	    private static byte[] GetPurposeBytes(string purpose)
> 115	    {
> 116	        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(purpose);
> 117	        return [.. AssociatedDataPrefix, .. Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(purpose)];
> 118	    }
> 119	}

> 72	    private async Task PersistSessionAsync(
> 73	        AIAgent agent,
> 74	        AgentSession session,
> 75	        OrchestrationDefinition definition,
> 76	        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 77	    {
> 78	        var serializedSession = await agent.SerializeSessionAsync(session, cancellationToken: cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 79	        var protectedSession = protector.Protect(
> 80	            Purpose(definition.Fingerprint),
> 81	            Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(serializedSession.GetRawText()));

> 88	        {

> 98	    private async Task<AgentSession> RestoreAsync(
> 99	        AIAgent agent,
> 100	        byte[] serialized,
> 101	        OrchestrationDefinition definition,
> 102	        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 103	    {
> 104	        DirectAgentSessionEnvelope stored;
> 105	
> 106	        try
> 107	        {
> 108	            stored = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<DirectAgentSessionEnvelope>(serialized)
> 109	                ?? throw RecoveryRequired();
> 110	        }
> 111	        catch (Exception failure) when (failure is JsonException or NotSupportedException)
> 112	        {
> 113	            throw RecoveryRequired(failure);
> 114	        }
> 115	
> 116	        if (stored.EnvelopeVersion != CurrentEnvelopeVersion
> 117	            || stored.Definition is null
> 118	            || stored.ProtectedSession is null)
> 119	        {
> 120	            throw RecoveryRequired();
> 121	        }
> 122	
> 123	        if (!string.Equals(stored.Definition.Fingerprint, definition.Fingerprint, StringComparison.Ordinal))
> 124	        {
> 125	            throw new InvalidOperationException(
> 126	                "The durable direct-agent session is incompatible with the current orchestration definition; an explicit migration or reset is required.");
> 127	        }
> 128	
> 129	        try
> 130	        {
> 131	            var sessionBytes = protector.Unprotect(Purpose(definition.Fingerprint), stored.ProtectedSession);
> 132	            using var sessionJson = JsonDocument.Parse(sessionBytes);
> 133	
> 134	            return await agent.DeserializeSessionAsync(
> 135	                sessionJson.RootElement.Clone(),
> 136	                cancellationToken: cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 137	        }
> 138	        catch (Exception failure) when (failure is CryptographicException
> 139	            or JsonException
> 140	            or FormatException
> 141	            or InvalidOperationException
> 142	            or NotSupportedException)
> 143	        {
> 144	            throw RecoveryRequired(failure);
> 145	        }
> 146	    }
> 147	
> 148	    private string Purpose(string definitionFingerprint)
> 149	        => $"{ProtectionPurposeRoot}.v{CurrentEnvelopeVersion}\n{neuron}\n{definitionFingerprint}";
> 150	
> 151	    private static InvalidOperationException RecoveryRequired(Exception? failure = null)
> 152	        => new(
> 153	            "The durable direct-agent session cannot be restored; an explicit migration or reset is required.",
> 154	            failure);
> 155	
> 156	    private sealed record DirectAgentSessionEnvelope(
> 157	        int EnvelopeVersion,
> 158	        OrchestrationDefinition Definition,
> 159	        byte[] ProtectedSession);
> 160	}

> 38	    {
> 39	        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(state);
> 40	
> 41	        var outcome = result is null
> 42	            ? CodeHubOutcome.AsNoCode()
> 43	            : CodeHubOutcome.AsCompleted(result);
> 44	
> 45	        Completions[state] = outcome;
> 46	        if (Waiters.TryGetValue(state, out var waiter))
> 47	        {
> 48	            waiter.TrySetResult(outcome);
> 49	        }
> 50	
> 51	        if (result is null)
> 52	        {
> 53	            if (SessionsByState.TryRemove(state, out var session))
> 54	            {
> 55	                SessionsByCommand.TryRemove(session.CommandId.Value, out _);
> 56	                session.Cancel();
> 57	            }
> 58	
> 59	            return;
> 60	        }
> 61	
> 62	        if (SessionsByState.TryRemove(state, out var completed))
> 63	        {
> 64	            SessionsByCommand.TryRemove(completed.CommandId.Value, out _);
> 65	        }
> 66	    }
> 67	
> 68	    internal static void AbortOpen(CommandId commandId)
> 69	    {
> 70	        if (SessionsByCommand.TryRemove(commandId.Value, out var session))
> 71	        {
> 72	            UnregisterSession(session);
> 73	            session.Cancel();
> 74	        }
> 75	    }
> 76	
> 77	    internal static void AbortAllOpenSessions()
> 78	    {
> 79	        foreach (var waiter in Waiters.Values.ToArray())
> 80	        {
> 81	            waiter.TrySetResult(CodeHubOutcome.AsNoCode());
> 82	        }
> 83	
> 84	        Waiters.Clear();
> 85	
> 86	        foreach (var session in SessionsByCommand.Values.ToArray())
> 87	        {
> 88	            session.Cancel();
> 89	        }
> 90	
> 91	        SessionsByCommand.Clear();
> 92	        SessionsByState.Clear();
> 93	    }

> 98	        Completions.Clear();
> 99	    }

> 101	    internal static async Task<McpAuthorizationCodeResult?> AwaitAsync(string state, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 102	    {
> 103	        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(state);
> 104	
> 105	        if (Completions.TryRemove(state, out var already))
> 106	        {
> 107	            return already.ToResult();
> 108	        }
> 109	
> 110	        var waiter = Waiters.GetOrAdd(
> 111	            state,
> 112	            static _ => new TaskCompletionSource<CodeHubOutcome>(
> 113	                TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously));
> 114	
> 115	        if (Completions.TryRemove(state, out already))
> 116	        {
> 117	            waiter.TrySetResult(already);
> 118	            Waiters.TryRemove(state, out _);
> 119	            return already.ToResult();
> 120	        }
> 121	
> 122	        await using (cancellationToken.Register(
> 123	            static target => ((TaskCompletionSource<CodeHubOutcome>)target!).TrySetCanceled(),
> 124	            waiter).ConfigureAwait(false))
> 125	        {
> 126	            try
> 127	            {
> 128	                var outcome = await waiter.Task.WaitAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 129	                Completions.TryRemove(state, out _);
> 130	                return outcome.ToResult();
> 131	            }
> 132	            finally
> 133	            {
> 134	                Waiters.TryRemove(state, out _);
> 135	            }
> 136	        }
> 137	    }

> **`src/Kernel/DigitalBrain.Kernel/MapBrainTopology.cs`** — MapBrainTopology(method), BrainTopologyHttpMaps(class), TopologyReplyBound(constant), DigitalBrain.Kernel(namespace)

> ```csharp
> 1	using DigitalBrain.Client;
> 2	using DigitalBrain.Introspection;
> 3	
> 4	namespace DigitalBrain.Kernel;
> 5	
> 6	internal static class BrainTopologyHttpMaps
> 7	{
> 8	    internal static readonly TimeSpan TopologyReplyBound = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(90);
> 9	
> 10	    public static IEndpointRouteBuilder MapBrainTopology(this IEndpointRouteBuilder endpoints)
> 11	    {
> 12	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(endpoints);
> 13	
> 14	        endpoints.MapGet(
> 15	            HttpSurfacePaths.BrainTopologyPath,
> 16	            static async Task<IResult> (
> 17	                IDigitalBrain brain,
> 18	                CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
> 19	            {
> 20	                ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(brain);
> 21	                cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
> 22	
> 23	                using var deadline = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken);
> 24	                deadline.CancelAfter(TopologyReplyBound);
> 25	
> 26	                TopologyRead read;
> 27	                try
> 28	                {
> 29	                    read = await brain
> 30	                        .Get<IIntrospection>()
> 31	                        .FireAsync(new ReadTopologyRequest(), deadline.Token)
> 32	                        .ConfigureAwait(false);
> 33	                }
> 34	                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
> 35	                {
> 36	                    return Results.Problem(
> 37	                        "The introspection neuron did not report topology within "
> 38	                        + $"{TopologyReplyBound.TotalSeconds} seconds.",
> 39	                        statusCode: StatusCodes.Status504GatewayTimeout);
> 40	                }
> 41	
> 42	                return Results.Ok(new BrainTopologySnapshot(
> 43	                    [.. read.Modules.Select(static module => new BrainModule(module))],
> 44	                    [
> 45	                        .. read.Neurons.Select(static neuron => new BrainNeuron(
> 46	                            neuron.Id,
> 47	                            neuron.GrainType,
> 48	                            neuron.Identity,
> 49	                            neuron.Placement)),
> 50	                    ],
> 51	                    read.ObservedAt,
> 52	                    [
> 53	                        .. read.Connections.Select(static connection => new BrainConnection(
> 54	                            connection.ConnectionId,
> 55	                            connection.Source,
> 56	                            connection.SynapseAlias,
> 57	                            connection.Target,
> 58	                            connection.Transform,
> 59	                            connection.ExpiresAt)),
> 60	                    ],
> 61	                    [
> 62	                        .. read.BroadcastRoutes.Select(static route => new BrainBroadcastRoute(
> 63	                            route.SynapseAlias,
> 64	                            route.HandlerGrainType)),
> 65	                    ]));
> 66	            });
> 67	
> 68	        return endpoints;
> 69	    }
> 70	}

> **`src/Modules/Introspection/Introspection/IntrospectionNeuron.Topology.cs`** — IntrospectionNeuron(class), ReadTopologyAsync(method), ActivatedOwnerNeuronsAsync(method), ActivatedNeuron(class), IdentityPartSeparator(constant), ModulesConfigurationSection(constant), +2 more
>
> ```csharp
> 1	using DigitalBrain.Abstractions;
> 2	using DigitalBrain.Core;
> 3	using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
> 4	using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
> 5	
> 6	namespace DigitalBrain.Introspection;
> 7	
> 8	public sealed partial class IntrospectionNeuron
> 9	{
> 10	    private const string ModulesConfigurationSection = "DigitalBrain:Modules";
> 11	    private const char IdentityPartSeparator = '/';
> 12	
> 13	    private async Task<ActivatedNeuron[]> ActivatedOwnerNeuronsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 14	    {
> 15	        var statistics = await GrainFactory
> 16	            .GetGrain<IManagementGrain>(0)
> 17	            .GetDetailedGrainStatistics()
> 18	            .WaitAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 19	
> 20	        var ownerPrefix = $"{Id.Owner.Value}{IdentityPartSeparator}";
> 21	
> 22	        return
> 23	        [
> 24	            .. statistics
> 25	                .Where(statistic => statistic.GrainId.Key.ToString()!
> 26	                    .StartsWith(ownerPrefix, StringComparison.Ordinal))
> 27	                .Select(static statistic => new ActivatedNeuron(
> 28	                    statistic.GrainId.Type.ToString()!,
> 29	                    statistic.GrainId.Key.ToString()!,
> 30	                    statistic.SiloAddress)),
> 31	        ];
> 32	    }
> 33	
> 34	    private async Task<TopologyRead> ReadTopologyAsync(CommandId commandId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 35	    {
> 36	        var ownerStatistics = await ActivatedOwnerNeuronsAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 37	        var connections = await GrainFactory
> 38	            .GetGrain<ISynapseGraph>(ISynapseGraph.ForOwner(Id.Owner).ToGrainId())
> 39	            .Connections()
> 40	            .WaitAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 41	        var placements = ownerStatistics
> 42	            .Select(static neuron => neuron.Silo)
> 43	            .Distinct()
> 44	            .OrderBy(static address => address.ToString(), StringComparer.Ordinal)
> 45	            .Select(static (address, index) => (Address: address, Label: $"cluster-{index + 1}"))
> 46	            .ToDictionary(static placement => placement.Address, static placement => placement.Label);
> 47	
> 48	        return new TopologyRead(
> 49	            commandId,
> 50	            ComposedModuleIds(),
> 51	            [
> 52	                .. ownerStatistics
> 53	                    .Select(neuron => new TopologyNeuron(
> 54	                        $"{neuron.Type}:{neuron.GrainKey}",
> 55	                        neuron.Type,
> 56	                        neuron.GrainKey,
> 57	                        placements[neuron.Silo]))
> 58	                    .OrderBy(static neuron => neuron.GrainType, StringComparer.Ordinal)
> 59	                    .ThenBy(static neuron => neuron.Identity, StringComparer.Ordinal),
> 60	            ],
> 61	            TimeProvider.GetUtcNow(),
> 62	            [
> 63	                .. connections
> 64	                    .Select(static connection => new TopologyConnection(
> 65	                        connection.ConnectionId,
> 66	                        connection.Source.ToString(),
> 67	                        connection.SynapseAlias,
> 68	                        connection.Target.ToString(),
> 69	                        connection.Transform,
> 70	                        connection.ExpiresAt))
> 71	                    .OrderBy(static connection => connection.Source, StringComparer.Ordinal)
> 72	                    .ThenBy(static connection => connection.SynapseAlias, StringComparer.Ordinal),
> 73	            ],
> 74	            [
> 75	                .. (ServiceProvider.GetService<BroadcastTopology>()?.Routes ?? [])
> 76	                    .Select(static route => new TopologyBroadcastRoute(
> 77	                        route.SynapseAlias,
> 78	                        route.HandlerGrainType)),
> 79	            ]);
> 80	    }
> 81	
> 82	    private sealed record ActivatedNeuron(string Type, string GrainKey, SiloAddress Silo);
> 83	
> 84	    private IReadOnlyList<string> ComposedModuleIds()
> 85	    {
> 86	        if (ServiceProvider.GetService<ActiveCapabilityCatalog>() is { Modules.Count: > 0 } catalog)
> 87	        {
> 88	            return
> 89	            [
> 90	                .. catalog.Modules
> 91	                    .Select(static module => module.ModuleId.Value)
> 92	                    .OrderBy(static id => id, StringComparer.Ordinal),
> 93	            ];
> 94	        }
> 95	
> 96	        if (ServiceProvider.GetService<IConfiguration>() is not { } configuration)
> 97	        {
> 98	            return [];
> 99	        }
> 100

> 102	        [

> 240	    private bool TryCreateJournalObserver(
> 241	        JournalKind kind,
> 242	        [NotNullWhen(true)] out ChannelJournalObserver? observer,
> 243	        [NotNullWhen(true)] out IJournalObserver? reference)
> 244	    {
> 245	        var candidate = new ChannelJournalObserver(kind);
> 246	        try
> 247	        {
> 248	            reference = _grains.CreateObjectReference<IJournalObserver>(candidate);
> 249	            observer = candidate;
> 250	            return true;
> 251	        }
> 252	        catch (InvalidOperationException ex) when (
> 253	            ex.Message.Contains("object reference", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
> 254	        {
> 255	            candidate.Complete();

> 257	            reference = null;
> 258	            return false;
> 259	        }

> 262	    private static async Task<Synapse> WaitForResponseAsync(
> 263	        ChannelJournalObserver observer,
> 264	        CorrelationId correlation,
> 265	        Type responseType,
> 266	        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 267	    {
> 268	        await foreach (var page in observer.Reads.ReadAllAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false))
> 269	        {
> 270	            foreach (var delivery in page.Delta)
> 271	            {
> 272	                if (delivery.CorrelationId == correlation
> 273	                    && responseType.IsInstanceOfType(delivery.Synapse))
> 274	                {
> 275	                    return delivery.Synapse;
> 276	                }
> 277	            }
> 278	        }
> 279	
> 280	        throw new InvalidOperationException(
> 281	            $"The session journal watch ended before a '{responseType.Name}' response arrived for correlation '{correlation}'.");
> 282	    }
> 283	
> 284	    private static async Task<Synapse> PollForResponseAsync(
> 285	        ISessionNeuron session,
> 286	        NeuronId sessionId,
> 287	        long cursor,
> 288	        CorrelationId correlation,
> 289	        Type responseType,
> 290	        CancellationToken cancellationToken)
> 291	    {
> 292	        while (true)
> 293	        {
> 294	            var read = await session.ReadNeuronJournal(sessionId, JournalKind.Incoming, cursor).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 295	            foreach (var candidate in read.Delta)
> 296	            {
> 297	                if (candidate.CorrelationId == correlation
> 298	                    && responseType.IsInstanceOfType(candidate.Synapse))
> 299	                {
> 300	                    return candidate.Synapse;
> 301	                }
> 302	            }
> 303	
> 304	            if (read.ResetSnapshot is not null)
> 305	            {
> 306	                throw new InvalidOperationException(
> 307	                    $"The session journal compacted past sequence {cursor} before a "
> 308	                    + $"'{responseType.Name}' response arrived for correlation '{correlation}'.");
> 309	            }
> 310	
> 311	            cursor = read.ResumeSequence;
> 312	            await Task.Delay(ResponsePollInterval, cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
> 313	        }
> 314	    }
> 315	    private async Task TeardownWatchAsync(

> 318	        IJournalObserver reference,

> 321	        try
> 322	        {
> 323	            await session.UnwatchNeuron(subject, reference).ConfigureAwait(false);

> 325	        catch (Exception)

> 327	        }

> 329	        try
> 330	        {
> 331	            _grains.DeleteObjectReference<IJournalObserver>(reference);
> 332	        }
> 333	        catch (Exception)
> 334	        {
> 335	        }
> 336	        finally
> 337	        {
> 338	            observer.Complete();
> 339	        }

## What CodeGraph revealed

Several findings materially change the plan:

- OAuth is a P0 defect, not just misplaced code. The current MCP path appears to create one manual Salesforce state/URL in [McpAuthorizationRail.cs](./src/Modules/SDK/DigitalBrain.Modules.Sdk/Mcp/McpAuthorizationRail.cs:87), then lets the MCP library create a different state later in [McpClientSessions.cs](./src/Modules/SDK/DigitalBrain.Modules.Sdk/Mcp/McpClientSessions.cs:17). The manual URL lacks PKCE, unknown callback states can fill an unbounded static dictionary, and completed codes remain replayable.
- `SynapseGraphNeuron` is not the whole DigitalBrain graph. It is a per-owner connection registry; delivery is distributed across messaging, relays, and outbox processing. It also stores `role:responder`, which is not a synapse route.
- Behavior Studio is currently a convincing mock. [main.dart](./src/Modules/UI/Flutter/shell/lib/main.dart) passes `behaviorClient: null`; `/behaviors` has no backend, compiler, artifact store, executor, approval enforcement, or sandbox.
- “Self-programming” currently means wiring precompiled contracts. It does not generate, load, or safely execute new behavior code.
- The project count is inflated in specific, removable places: Salesforce has an empty Contracts project and two roughly 25-line projects. Conversely, `DigitalBrain.Security` is small but not pointless: it centralizes AES-GCM envelopes, purpose-separated key derivation, nonce/AAD handling, and protection used by AI, Google, and MCP.
- The current `DigitalBrain.Kernel` is actually the HTTP/composition host. The inward runtime kernel is mostly `DigitalBrain.Core`.
- AppHost composition and [DigitalBrainComposition.cs](./src/Kernel/DigitalBrain.Kernel/DigitalBrainComposition.cs:7) independently describe modules, creating two sources of truth.
- The IAW agents are useful references, but unsafe templates. `AspireAgent` exposes mutation commands alongside diagnostics; `RoslynAgent` mixes whole-solution analysis with direct file writing. Loading the whole repository into an agent is also infeasible: approximately 303k source tokens versus the current agent’s 16k context.

## Three delivery strategies

1. **Stabilize and strangle — recommended.** Add characterization gates around today’s behavior, fix P0 defects, then replace one seam per iteration while the product remains runnable.
2. **Big-bang architecture rewrite.** Faster visual cleanup, but OAuth, graph behavior, Flutter contracts, and scripting could all break simultaneously.
3. **Cosmetic project consolidation.** Low immediate risk, but it leaves the fake Behavior backend, unsafe scripting boundary, and duplicated composition model untouched.

I recommend option 1.

## Five prioritized architecture moves

### 1. Establish a product stability gate

Iteration 1 should probably be narrow:

- Prove and then replace the OAuth state flow.
- Bound, expire, consume, and owner-bind authorization state.
- Add fake-provider end-to-end PKCE tests, callback replay/expiry tests, and restart/multi-silo tests.
- Add Flutter core tests to CI; current CI runs only .NET.
- Add an AppHost smoke lane and architecture dependency checks.
- Pin CodeGraph instead of invoking `@latest`.
- Decide whether the product spine stays on preview .NET/Aspire or moves to stable LTS.
- Prove unused Orleans Streams/PubSub infrastructure before deleting it; current live telemetry is dominated by idle Azure Queue polling.

Changing test frameworks is not the main win. The missing test layers and product gates are.

### 2. Rationalize projects around real boundaries

My proposed rule: a project survives only if it owns a genuine package, deployment, dependency-isolation, or deep policy boundary.

Concrete outcome:

- Rename `DigitalBrain.Kernel` to `DigitalBrain.Host` or `DigitalBrain.HttpHost`.
- Delete `DigitalBrain.Modules.Salesforce.Contracts`.
- Represent Salesforce as configuration for the generic MCP module; remove its one-class runtime project.
- Fold Salesforce/Google Aspire adapters into AppHost unless independent provider packages are a real distribution goal.
- Replace the two composition lists with one product module catalog projected into runtime and Aspire.
- Delete or quarantine unreferenced Webhook and token-presence slices after characterization.
- Keep `DigitalBrain.Security`, but rename it to something precise such as `DigitalBrain.StateProtection`, strip unused dependencies, and add rotation support.

Your instinct about project trash is right; `Security` is simply not the best deletion target.

### 3. Build a deep, provider-neutral authorization module

I would not put all authorization into `Modules.Sdk`; that would preserve today’s accidental god-package.

```text
DigitalBrain.Abstractions/Authorization/
    requests, challenges, outcomes

DigitalBrain.Core/Authorization/OAuth/
    durable transaction, state, PKCE, expiry, callback coordination

DigitalBrain.Modules.Mcp/OAuth/
    MCP provider adapter

DigitalBrain.Modules.Google/OAuth/
    Google provider adapter

DigitalBrain.StateProtection/
    provider-independent encrypted state
```

The external seam should be approximately:

```text
EnsureAuthorized(request) -> Authorized | Challenge | Denied
CompleteCallback(callback) -> Accepted | Unknown | Expired
```

Raw codes, PKCE verifiers, token persistence, continuation machinery, and replay prevention stay hidden behind it.

### 4. Clarify the programming model and build Behavior for real

I recommend:

- Rename the existing class to `ConnectionRegistryNeuron`.
- Better still, split:
  - `SynapseRouteRegistryNeuron`
  - `RoleDirectoryNeuron`
- Reserve `DigitalBrainGraph` for a composite read model containing modules, active neurons, routes, roles, tasks, health, and operational evidence.
- Separate directed handling from global broadcast subscription; `IHandle<T>` currently means both.
- Validate source aliases, targets, handler compatibility, transforms, duplicate edges, and role cardinality at connection time.
- Introduce graph versions and atomic change sets for activation/rollback.
- Move the hard-coded “time button” detector out of `Chat` and into an explicit behavior or policy revision.

For runtime-generated behaviors:

```text
Draft
  -> immutable revision
  -> isolated build
  -> deterministic scenarios
  -> permission diff
  -> approval
  -> atomic activation
  -> isolated execution
  -> mediated/journaled effects
```

Declarative steps—transform, branch, capability call, emit—should cover the common case. C# can remain an escape hatch, but it must run out of process without clustering credentials, unrestricted `IDigitalBrain`, ambient secrets, arbitrary NuGet, or unrestricted network/filesystem access.

### 5. Add a read-only Engineering control plane

Do not copy the IAW agents and do not preload the codebase.

The smallest safe shape is:

- `IEngineering.Investigate(question, scope) -> cited report`
- An `EngineeringNeuron` that does not inherit the current general-purpose `Agent`, because that automatically receives the mutating `fire` tool.
- A development-only, out-of-process evidence broker.
- Allowlisted reads from:
  - existing Introspection topology and journal metadata;
  - CodeGraph selected-symbol/dependency queries;
  - Roslyn immutable solution snapshots as a fallback;
  - Aspire resources, logs, and traces;
  - a separate supported metrics store later.
- Every item tagged with source revision, running build revision, observation time, locator, truncation status, and redaction status.
- No shell, restart, deploy, code writes, or raw environment dictionaries.

The current [.mcp.json](./.mcp.json:3) already provides much of this to an external development agent. An in-product Engineering module is justified only when DigitalBrain itself must expose that understanding to its owner.

## Grill question 1: autonomy boundary

Should generated behaviors be allowed to activate without your approval?

My recommendation is a hybrid:

- Declarative revisions may auto-activate only when every effect stays inside an already approved capability/permission envelope.
- Any generated C#, new provider access, broader data scope, network access, or permission expansion requires owner approval bound to the exact immutable revision hash.
- Generated code never runs inside the Kernel/Host process.

Do you approve that boundary, or do you want either stricter approval for every revision or full autonomous activation?

> Yes, they allowed to be executed autonomusly, becaue there would be only one approval on creation after that they are discoverable and executable. But the question is wrong, lets narron and focus on Stabilize and strangle first.

Agreed—the autonomy question was premature.

I’ve recorded the rule: a behavior receives one approval when created, scoped to its immutable revision and permissions. After approval, it is discoverable and executes autonomously. A material edit becomes a new revision requiring approval.

For now, we exclude Behavior, Engineering, graph renaming, and project consolidation. “Stabilize and strangle” starts by defining the supported product boundary, reproducing failures, adding characterization tests, and only then replacing defective seams.

First narrow question:

For the first production-quality milestone, can we define DigitalBrain as a **single-owner, local-first system running on one trusted machine through AppHost**, with remote and multi-user deployment explicitly deferred?

My recommendation is yes. Otherwise, Iteration 1 must also introduce user identity, sessions, endpoint authorization, owner resolution, and multi-tenant OAuth—turning stabilization into a platform rewrite.

How does it alight? which options for identity orleans provides? it would be deployed not for millons users, but teams in private azure resource group.

> 71	        }
> 72	
> 73	        if (_pending.TryGetValue(request.State, out var existingSerialized))
> 74	        {
> 75	            var existing = _serializer.Deserialize(existingSerialized);
> 76	            if (existing.CommandId != request.CommandId
> 77	                || !string.Equals(existing.ServerKey, request.ServerKey, StringComparison.Ordinal)
> 78	                || existing.SignInUrl != request.SignInUrl)
> 79	            {
> 80	                throw new InvalidOperationException(
> 81	                    $"Authorization state '{request.State}' is already pending for a different request.");
> 82	            }
> 83	
> 84	            return new AuthorizationRequired(
> 85	                existing.CommandId,
> 86	                existing.ServerKey,
> 87	                existing.ServerDisplayName,
> 88	                existing.SignInUrl,
> 89	                existing.State);
> 90	        }
> 91	
> 92	        var pending = new PendingAuthorization(
> 93	            request.CommandId,
> 94	            request.ServerKey,
> 95	            request.ServerDisplayName,
> 96	            request.SignInUrl,
> 97	            request.State,
> 98	            Outcome: PendingAuthorizationOutcome.Open,
> 99	            Code: null,
> 100	            Iss: null,
> 101	            CompletionTarget: null,
> 102	            CompletionNotified: false,
> 103	            RequestingNeuron: CaptureRequestingNeuron());
> 104	        _pending[request.State] = _serializer.SerializeToArray(pending);
> 105	        _commands[request.CommandId.Value] = _commandsSerializer.SerializeToArray(
> 106	            ToCommandRecord(pending));
> 107	        await WriteStateAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(true);
> 108	
> 109	        var required = new AuthorizationRequired(
> 110	            request.CommandId,
> 111	            request.ServerKey,
> 112	            request.ServerDisplayName,
> 113	            request.SignInUrl,
> 114	            request.State);
> 115	        await EmitAsync(required).ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 116	        // Directed into the owner's main chat so the transcript shows a
> 117	        // "Sign in via {server}" button (Emit alone only hits broadcast ghosts).
> 118	        await SendAsync(new NeuronId("chat", Id.Owner, "main"), required)
> 119	            .ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 120	        return required;
> 121	    }

> 177	    public async Task<McpAuthorizationCallbackDelivery> DeliverCallback(
> 178	        DeliverMcpAuthorizationCallback delivery,
> 179	        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
> 180	    {
> 181	        ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(delivery);
> 182	        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(delivery.State);
> 183	        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
> 184	
> 185	        if (!_pending.TryGetValue(delivery.State, out var serialized))
> 186	        {
> 187	
> 188	            McpAuthorizationCodeHub.Complete(delivery.State, result: null);
> 189	            return new McpAuthorizationCallbackDelivery(Accepted: false, Completed: false, Denied: false);
> 190	        }
> 191	
> 192	        var pending = _serializer.Deserialize(serialized);
> 193	        if (pending.Outcome is not PendingAuthorizationOutcome.Open)
> 194	        {
> 195	            if (pending.Outcome is PendingAuthorizationOutcome.Completed
> 196	                && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pending.Code))

> 201	            }
> 202	            else if (pending.Outcome is PendingAuthorizationOutcome.Denied)

> 211	            return new McpAuthorizationCallbackDelivery(
> 212	                Accepted: true,
> 213	                Completed: pending.Outcome is PendingAuthorizationOutcome.Completed,
> 214	                Denied: pending.Outcome is PendingAuthorizationOutcome.Denied);

> 225	            await NotifyCompletionTargetAsync(pending).ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);
> 226	            return new McpAuthorizationCallbackDelivery(Accepted: true, Completed: false, Denied: true);
> 227	        }
> 228	
> 229	        pending = await PersistOutcomeAsync(
> 230	            pending,

> 239	        await NotifyCompletionTargetAsync(pending).ConfigureAwait(ConfigureAwaitOptions.ContinueOnCapturedContext);

> 243	    public Task<McpAuthorizationClaim> Claim(CommandId commandId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
> 244	    {
> 245	        if (commandId.Value == Guid.Empty)
> 246	        {
> 247	            throw new ArgumentException("The command id cannot be empty.", nameof(commandId));
> 248	        }
> 249	
> 250	        cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
> 251	
> 252	        if (!_commands.TryGetValue(commandId.Value, out var serialized))
> 253	        {

> 255	        }
> 256

> 259	        {

> 343	    private async Task<PendingAuthorization> PersistOutcomeAsync(

That aligns well—but it changes the model from “owner = user” to “owner = workspace.”

A personal DigitalBrain is a workspace with one member. A shared DigitalBrain is the same object with multiple members. One Azure installation can host several personal and shared workspaces.

## Identity model

| Concept | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `PrincipalId` | Human identity, preferably Entra `tenant-id + object-id` |
| `WorkspaceId` | One DigitalBrain and its isolation boundary |
| `Membership` | Principal’s role inside a workspace |
| `ActorContext` | Who initiated the current operation |
| `AutomationPrincipal` | Approved behavior executing autonomously |
| `ConnectionId` | Gmail, Salesforce, or another delegated/shared credential |

The current `OwnerId` is already embedded in every [NeuronId](./src/Kernel/DigitalBrain.Abstractions/Identity/NeuronId.cs:10), so structurally it is close to `WorkspaceId`. The main defect is that the host creates one singleton `IDigitalBrain` for owner `"dev"` in [DigitalBrainClientHostingExtensions.cs](./src/Kernel/Aspire/DigitalBrain.Aspire/DigitalBrainClientHostingExtensions.cs:12). HTTP requests therefore cannot select a workspace or represent a human caller.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    U["User or guest"] --> E["Microsoft Entra ID"]
    E --> H["Authenticated DigitalBrain Host"]
    H --> M["Workspace membership check"]
    M --> F["Workspace-scoped brain factory"]
    F --> G["Orleans grains keyed by WorkspaceId"]

    B["Approved behavior"] --> A["Automation principal"]
    A --> M
```

## What identity Orleans provides

Orleans does **not** provide human authentication, login, users, teams, or workspace membership.

It provides useful mechanics underneath your application identity model:

| Orleans feature | Appropriate use | Limitation |
|---|---|---|
| Grain identity: type + key | Put `WorkspaceId` into every grain identity | This isolates addresses, but does not prove the caller is allowed |
| `RequestContext` | Propagate a compact `ActorContext` through a grain-call chain | Caller-provided metadata is not authentication and is not durable |
| Incoming/outgoing call filters | Reject missing or workspace-mismatched actor context; add auditing | Authentication must already have happened at the trusted ingress |
| Orleans TLS/mTLS | Secure silo and client transport | Identifies services, not dashboard users |
| External client architecture | ASP.NET host authenticates users and then calls grains | The Orleans gateway must remain private |

Microsoft’s Orleans guidance explicitly places user authentication and authorization in the frontend before it calls grains. [`RequestContext`](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/orleans/grains/request-context) then propagates serializable metadata, and [grain call filters](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/orleans/grains/interceptors) can enforce policies. Orleans grain identities are fundamentally a type and key—not user accounts. [Orleans client guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/orleans/host/client)

I would propagate only something compact:

```text
ActorContext
  WorkspaceId
  PrincipalId
  MembershipRole
  CorrelationId
  AuthenticationMethod
```

For commands that become durable, the actor stamp must also be persisted in the command/journal. `RequestContext` alone disappears across reminders, retries, restarts, and later autonomous execution.

## Recommended identity stack

For a private Azure installation serving up to 100 people:

1. **Microsoft Entra workforce tenant** authenticates humans.
2. **Entra B2B guests** handle friends and external collaborators using their existing identity. [Entra B2B](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/external-id/what-is-b2b)
3. ASP.NET Core validates OIDC cookies for the browser dashboard and bearer tokens for Flutter/API access.
4. Entra app roles cover installation-wide roles such as `PlatformAdmin`.
5. DigitalBrain stores workspace-specific roles such as:
   - `Owner`
   - `Admin`
   - `Builder`
   - `Member`
   - `Viewer`
6. An `IDigitalBrainFactory` replaces the singleton client:

```text
ForWorkspace(workspaceId, actorContext) -> IDigitalBrain
```

7. Every endpoint performs resource-based workspace authorization before obtaining that client.
8. Azure Managed Identity authenticates the deployed services to Storage, Key Vault, and other Azure resources. It does not represent users.

App roles are suitable for coarse application roles, while product workspace membership should remain inside DigitalBrain rather than creating an Entra group for every personal brain. [Entra app roles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/howto-add-app-roles-in-apps)

Azure Container Apps can also enforce Entra authentication at ingress, but application-level workspace authorization is still required. A resource group alone is a management boundary; it does not protect the dashboard endpoint. [Container Apps authentication](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/container-apps/authentication)

## Autonomous behaviors

The prior decision fits this model:

- A user approves a behavior revision and its permission manifest once.
- Execution then uses a workspace-owned `AutomationPrincipal`, not the approving user’s live session.
- The audit records `ApprovedBy` and `ExecutedAs`.
- The behavior can only use explicitly approved `ConnectionId` values.
- Gmail connections can be user-owned; Salesforce can be workspace-owned.
- Removing a user can automatically disable behaviors dependent on that user’s connections.

## Revised stabilization slice

Before OAuth repair or project consolidation:

1. Formalize `Principal`, `Workspace`, `Membership`, and `AutomationPrincipal`.
2. Replace singleton `"dev"` resolution with a workspace-scoped brain factory.
3. Authenticate every HTTP/SSE endpoint.
4. Add workspace membership authorization and actor propagation.
5. Bind OAuth transactions and connector credentials to workspace plus credential subject.
6. Add cross-workspace denial, role, guest, SSE, OAuth, and audit tests.

No graph renaming, Behavior backend, Engineering agent, or project collapse belongs in this slice.

My next narrow question: can the first supported Azure installation belong to one Entra workforce tenant, with friends and partners invited as B2B guests, while that installation hosts multiple personal and shared DigitalBrains?

I recommend yes. A multitenant Entra application or customer-facing External ID should be deferred until you need self-service users from unrelated organizations.
